name: Audacia S.A.
summary: Audacia SAS is a private equity and venture capital firm, specializing in a diverse range of investments that span from early-stage startups and emerging growth ventures to mature businesses and family-owned small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). The firm also engages in mezzanine financing and real estate investments. While considering opportunities across all sectors, Audacia exhibits a particular focus on consumer goods, the hotel and catering industry, industrial companies, Business-to-Business (B2B) and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) services, and cutting-edge areas such as quantum communication, quantum computing, innovative physics, and quantum sensor technology. Its investment activities are predominantly concentrated within France. Audacia typically deploys between €2 million and €10 million through convertible bonds, alongside equity investments that range from €0.5 million to €1.5 million. The firm generally targets companies with annual sales revenues falling between €5 million and €250 million. Established in 2007, Audacia SAS operates from its headquarters in Paris, France.
